name: Hotel Schwarzer Adler
beschreibung: Hotel Schwarzer Adler is a traditionally run establishment in Nauders, Tirol. The accommodation is located at the Reschenpass at an altitude of around 1,300 meters, directly at the Dreiländereck Österreich-Italien-Schweiz. The guest rooms are furnished in Alpine style. The wellness area includes a Finnish sauna, a steam bath and a relaxation room. In the hotel's own restaurant, regional dishes from Tirol are served. Overnight stays with breakfast buffet or half board are offered. In summer, the hotel is suitable as a base for hiking and mountain bike tours; in winter, guests have direct access to the slopes of the Nauders ski area. The hotel provides free parking.
